queries.query: Jizhou Tianjin China official cadastral parcel map land registry cadastral service
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Tianjin Tianditu, the Tianjin public geographic information platform operated by Tianjin Municipal Planning and Natural Resources Bureau / Tianjin Surveying and Mapping Geographic Information Research Center. Its official help page describes cadastral-registration thematic data, while the official bureau site publishes Jizhou real-estate registration notices. No public anonymous parcel-vector endpoint was verified.

queries.result: 官方中文检索结果确认蓟州区存在不动产登记公告和由天津市规划和自然资源局承办的天地图·天津公共地理信息平台；平台说明包含不动产登记等专题数据，但未提供可匿名取得安全宗地身份和完整宗地几何的公开响应。

registryCustodian: Tianjin Municipal Planning and Natural Resources Bureau and its Jizhou district planning/natural-resources administration are evidenced as the local/nationally delegated cadastral and real-estate-registration custodians for Jizhou; official bureau pages publish Jizhou land and building registration notices. This establishes a registry custodian, not an open parcel-geometry API.

registryEvidence.interpretation: The first-party Tianjin bureau and public platform explicitly evidence Jizhou registration notices and cadastral-related public information services. No claim is made that parcel vectors are anonymously downloadable.

sourceReview.service: Tianjin Tianditu public geographic information platform; Tianjin Municipal Planning and Natural Resources Bureau Jizhou registration notices
sourceReview.crs: unverified; no parcel geometry response obtained

requestOutcomes.outcome: Anonymous TLS-verified curl request failed before HTTP with certificate-expired error. No TLS verification bypass was used; no HTML, JavaScript/configuration, service route, schema, CRS, parcel ID, or geometry was obtained.

Official documentation was discoverable and states that Tianjin Tianditu is a public geographic information platform with vector maps, imagery, terrain, place/address data and thematic data including real-estate registration. It did not expose an anonymous parcel feature response in the inspected material.
Official map page was identified and lists Jizhou map products/download views. It is cartographic map material, not evidence of a parcel-vector service or safe parcel identity response.
Official bureau page returned search-indexed Jizhou real-estate registration notices, including land/building registration notices. No parcel polygon or public query API was returned.

Official Tianjin real-estate registration standard was identified; it documents cadastral/parcel registration concepts and field structure at policy level, but does not provide public parcel geometry for Jizhou. No unsafe fields were requested.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not performed against parcel geometry because no usable anonymous parcel service response was obtained. Exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
